description: This file defines various data validation classes for the marshmallow library, including validators for URLs, emails, ranges, lengths, equality, regex patterns, and sequence contents.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: Abstract base class for validators, providing a __repr__ method and an abstract __call__ method.

classes.name: And
classes.description: Validator that composes multiple validators and combines their error messages.

classes.name: URL
classes.description: Validator for URLs, supporting relative, absolute, schemes, and TLD requirements.

classes.name: Email
classes.description: Validator for email addresses, using regex patterns for user and domain parts.

classes.name: Range
classes.description: Validator that checks if a value falls within a specified range with inclusive/exclusive bounds.

classes.name: Length
classes.description: Validator that checks if a value's length is within specified bounds or exactly equal.

classes.name: Equal
classes.description: Validator that checks if a value is equal to a specified comparable.

classes.name: Regexp
classes.description: Validator that checks if a string or bytes match a regex pattern.

classes.name: Predicate
classes.description: Validator that calls a method on the value and succeeds if it returns True.

classes.name: NoneOf
classes.description: Validator that fails if the value is in a specified iterable.

classes.name: OneOf
classes.description: Validator that succeeds if the value is in a set of choices, with options for labels and options.

classes.name: ContainsOnly
classes.description: Validator that succeeds if all elements in a sequence are in a set of choices.

classes.name: ContainsNoneOf
classes.description: Validator that fails if any element in a sequence is in a specified iterable.
